name: NWS Austin/San Antonio
text: Above-average warmth (85°F to 95°F) with gusty winds today. Warmth lasts through midweek before a cold front results in a cooler weekend. Rain chances focus along and east of I-35 early to midweek, with additional rain chances arriving with the front later in the work week. #txwx pic.twitter.com/5EGWyZ4Is3
